note: 保留集（held-out）：模拟产品经理/运营的真实口语问法。规则引擎没有为这些句式写过规则，用来测泛化能力，避免自建集自测的过拟合。

cases.q: 最近一周各渠道的活跃玩家数
cases.gold: SELECT u.channel AS dim, COUNT(DISTINCT da.user_id) AS metric FROM daily_active da JOIN users u ON da.user_id = u.user_id WHERE da.log_date >= '2026-06-24' AND da.log_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY u.channel
SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30'

cases.q: 上个月各渠道新增了多少人
cases.gold: SELECT u.channel AS dim, COUNT(*) AS metric FROM users u WHERE u.register_date >= '2026-05-01' AND u.register_date <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY u.channel

cases.q: 最近30天各VIP等级贡献了多少流水
cases.gold: SELECT u.vip_level AS dim, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY u.vip_level

cases.q: 最近30天卖得最好的3个商品
cases.gold: SELECT pr.product_name AS dim, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY pr.product_name ORDER BY metric DESC LIMIT 3
SELECT pr.product_type AS dim, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id GROUP BY pr.product_type
SELECT COUNT(*) AS metric FROM users u

cases.q: 每天的新增用户（最近7天）
cases.gold: SELECT u.register_date AS dim, COUNT(*) AS metric FROM users u WHERE u.register_date >= '2026-06-24' AND u.register_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY u.register_date
SELECT ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-17' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30'
SELECT pr.product_type AS dim, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN products pr ON p.product_id = pr.product_id GROUP BY pr.product_type

cases.q: 最近30天各渠道平均每个付费用户花多少钱
cases.gold: SELECT u.channel AS dim, ROUND(SUM(p.amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY u.channel

cases.q: 上个月每一天的订单量
cases.gold: SELECT p.order_date AS dim, COUNT(*) AS metric FROM purchases p WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-05-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-05-31' GROUP BY p.order_date

cases.q: 哪个渠道的付费用户最多
cases.gold: SELECT u.channel AS dim, COUNT(DISTINCT p.user_id) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.channel ORDER BY metric DESC LIMIT 1

cases.q: 最近30天各国家的总收入是多少
cases.gold: SELECT u.country AS dim, ROUND(SUM(p.amount), 2) AS metric FROM purchases p JOIN users u ON p.user_id = u.user_id WHERE p.order_date >= '2026-06-01' AND p.order_date <= '2026-06-30' GROUP BY u.country
SELECT ROUND(AVG(da.play_minutes), 2) AS metric FROM daily_active da WHERE da.log_date >= '2026-06-24' AND da.log_date <= '2026-06-30'
